meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列开展结合与稳定性实验,取回测定结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做蛋白工程实验,想要一套清晰的送检与结果获取指南。
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for binding and stability assays, then retrieve results.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Adaptyv Bio Foundry API 与 Python SDK 的用法帮你设计、提交蛋白质实验并取回结果:查靶点、估算费用、创建与提交实验、跟踪状态,结果约 21 天返回。
howto.when: 当你提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、BLI/SPR 等结合或热稳定性检测,想提交蛋白序列做实验表征,或代码里出现 adaptyv、FoundryClient 等导入时接管。

say.text: 帮我查一下 EGFR 这个靶点,看能不能自助提交实验
say.note: 列出匹配靶点并返回 target_id

say.text: 用 BLI 做一次结合筛选,先估算费用再创建实验
say.note: 先返回费用估算,再建为 Draft
调用 get_results,报告结果状态

howto.what_en: Claude will follow the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK to help design, submit, and retrieve protein experiments: browse targets, estimate cost, create and submit experiments, poll status, and fetch results (about 21 days).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Adaptyv, Foundry API, BLI/SPR or thermostability assays, want to submit protein sequences for characterization, or when code imports adaptyv or FoundryClient.

say_en.text: Find an EGFR target and check if I can submit a self-service experiment.
say_en.note: Lists matching targets and returns a target_id.

say_en.text: Set up a BLI binding screen; estimate the cost first, then create it.
say_en.note: Returns a cost estimate, then creates a Draft experiment.

say_en.text: Fetch the results for that experiment.
